response.sql: WITH grouped_data AS (SELECT u.acctscope, COUNT(r.riskandmarginpivot) as record_count FROM riskandmargin r INNER JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault INNER JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp GROUP BY u.acctscope), totals AS (SELECT SUM(record_count) as total_count, COUNT(*) as scope_count, SUM(record_count) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) as avg_count FROM grouped_data) SELECT g.acctscope, g.record_count, g.record_count * 1.0 / t.total_count as fraction, g.record_count * 1.0 / t.avg_count as divided_by_average FROM grouped_data g CROSS JOIN totals t
